ptvm-p01-v01.quick_english: Unsurpassable how O Lord, at once Kaula-accomplishment-giving, by which by mere recognition to Khecarī-evenness may go.

ptvm-p01-v02.quick_english: This secret great secret tell to me O Lord; heart-abiding but which power, Kaulikī clan-mistress.

ptvm-p01-v03.quick_english: Her to me tell O Lord of gods, by which to fullness I gain — hear O Goddess O great fortuned, of answer even unsurpassable.

ptvm-p01-v04.quick_english: Kaula this rite O Goddess, of me standing in heart-sky; I tell O lady of gods, at once Kaula-accomplishment-giving.

ptvm-p01-v05.quick_english: Now first moon-days all, vowels ending in drop; inside that by time-yoking, moon-sun proclaimed.

ptvm-p01-v06.quick_english: Earth-beginning realities, ending with person, in five in order, in ka-etc, in sounds, in ma-sound-ending, O fair vowed.

ptvm-p01-v07.quick_english: Of wind-fire-water-lords, of supports fourfold; above that famed beginning with śa, before, brahma-five.

ptvm-p01-v08.quick_english: Rootless, that-ordered to be known, ending in kṣa emanation declared; of all indeed of mantras, of wisdoms and, O famed lady.

ptvm-p01-v09.quick_english: This womb told fully in all tantras in every way; joined with fourteen O lucky lady, joined with tithi-lord-end; third brahma O fair hipped, heart of Bhairava-self.

ptvm-p02-v10.quick_english: This not yoginī-born, not Rudra gets plainly — heart of god of gods, at once yoga-release-giving.

ptvm-p02-v11.quick_english: On its utterance when made, rightly mantra-seal-host great — at once to face-to-faceness goes, marked by own-body-possession.

ptvm-p02-v12.quick_english: A moment remembers who, in kiss navel-sealed — binds then all, mantra-seal-host, man.

ptvm-p02-v13.quick_english: Past-future-things asked he tells even; within a watch what meant, god-form voicing.

ptvm-p02-v14.quick_english: Face to face sees undoubted drawn by Rudra-powers; by mere two watches sky-standing becomes remembering.

ptvm-p02-v15.quick_english: By three mothers all, yogeśvarīs mighty; heroes, hero-lords, perfected, strong śākinī-host.

ptvm-p02-v16.quick_english: Having come, pledge having got, by Bhairava urged — they give supreme accomplishment, fruit which or desired.

ptvm-p02-v17.quick_english: By this accomplished ones will accomplish, and effect mantra-men; whatever in Bhairava-tantra, all from this succeeds.

ptvm-p02-v18.quick_english: Unseen circle even thus who anyone knows truly — he sharing accomplishment may be ever, he yogin, he and initiated.

ptvm-p03-v19.quick_english: By this by mere known, is known by all powers; śākinī-clan-common may be yoga, even without, for.

ptvm-p03-v20.quick_english: Unknowing rite, knowing ordinance becomes toward worship; time-fire from the beginning having made, ending in māyā, gone in brahma-body.

ptvm-p03-v21.quick_english: Śiva whose end is boundless all, supreme power-triad deemed; inside that being whatever, on pure path standing.

ptvm-p03-v22.quick_english: Atom pure before long lordly, knowing reaches; its impeller Śiva to be known, all-knowing supreme lord.

ptvm-p03-v23.quick_english: All-going, stainless, clear-full, self-aboded, bright; as in banyan seed standing, power-formed great tree.

ptvm-p03-v24.quick_english: So standing in heart-seed world this moving-unmoving; thus who knows in truth, of him going-to-freedom.

ptvm-p03-v25.quick_english: Initiation becomes-undoubted, free from sesame-ghee-offering; on crown, on face and, on heart, on hidden, on form so indeed and.

ptvm-p03-v26.quick_english: Placing having done, topknot having bound, enchanted with twenty-seven; with each one but of directions binding, of ten even should yoke.

ptvm-p03-v27.quick_english: Three claps before having given with sound for obstacle-quelling; by topknot-count muttered, with water should sprinkle then.

ptvm-p04-v28.quick_english: Flower etc in order all, mark or altar or; by fourteen muttered, with flower seat-making.

ptvm-p04-v29.quick_english: There emanation should worship hero, very seat again then; emanation but having put in casket, again worship should begin.

ptvm-p04-v30.quick_english: Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — should worship goddess O great lady, enchanted with twenty-seven.

ptvm-p04-v31.quick_english: Then with fragrant flowers according to power should honor; should worship with supreme devotion, self and should offer.

ptvm-p04-v32.quick_english: Thus worship told in fire-rite even this rule; whose worship-rule done, rightly remembering seed succeeds.

ptvm-p04-v33.quick_english: Without beginning end, seed blossoming gone mid-tithis; gone inside heart-lotus should meditate, moon-ray ever should practise.

ptvm-p04-v34.quick_english: Which which desires, desires them them quickly may get; from this to direct sight goes, all-knowingness no doubt.

ptvm-p04-v35.quick_english: Thus mantra-fruit-getting thus this Rudrayāmala; from this practice accomplishment, all-knowingness is got.

ptvm-p01-v01.inference: The question seeks the how of the unsurpassable granting Kaula fruit at once, known by mere touch.
premises: At once Kaula-fruit-granting (immediacy, not autonomy — recension decides).
By mere recognition: to Khecarī-evenness (the engine and goal).
ptvm-p01-v01.question: What is asked?
ptvm-p01-v01.speaker: Devī (asking)

ptvm-p01-v02.inference: The secret asked is the heart-abiding Kaulikī, mistress of the clan.
premises: This secret, great secret — tell me (the doubled secrecy).
ptvm-p01-v02.question: What secret?
ptvm-p01-v02.speaker: Devī (asking)

ptvm-p01-v03.inference: Devī asks fullness (gaining, not going); Bhairava answers: hear — even of the answer, the unsurpassable.
premises: Her tell me, Lord of gods, for my fullness — I gain (her half).
Even of the answer: the unsurpassable (answer beyond answers).
ptvm-p01-v03.question: Who asks and answers?
ptvm-p01-v03.speaker: Devī and Bhairava (turning)

ptvm-p01-v04.inference: Kaula rite standing in heart-sky — I tell, O lady of gods, at once Kaula-fruit-granting.
premises: Kaula this rite, O Goddess, in my heart-sky standing (transposed order kept).
I tell, O lady of gods (the feminine addressee).
ptvm-p01-v04.question: What is told?
ptvm-p01-v04.speaker: Bhairava (promising)
uncertainties: v4 halves transposed vs GRETIL order — file order kept, flagged

ptvm-p01-v05.inference: First: drop-ending vowels; moon-sun proclaimed inside by time's yoking.
premises: Now-first moon-days all, vowels ending in drop (the alphabet opened).
ptvm-p01-v05.question: What is first?
ptvm-p01-v05.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptvm-p01-v06.inference: Earth-to-person realities in five ka-classes, in sounds, ma-ending.
premises: In ka-etc. sounds, ma-ending (phonemes, not mere classes).
ptvm-p01-v06.question: What realities?
ptvm-p01-v06.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptvm-p01-v07.inference: Fourfold supports of wind-fire-water lords; above, śa-famed brahma-five.
premises: Above that, famed beginning with śa.
ptvm-p01-v07.question: What supports?
ptvm-p01-v07.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptvm-p01-v08.inference: Rootless, that-ordered, kṣa-ending emanation declared — of all mantras and wisdoms.
premises: Rootless, ordered, kṣa-ending (the a..kṣa arc, non-contiguous mūla).
Of all mantras and wisdoms (the scope).
ptvm-p01-v08.question: What emanation?
ptvm-p01-v08.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)

ptvm-p01-v09.inference: This womb told in all tantras in every way — fourteen-joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.
premises: This womb, told fully, everywhere, in every way.
Third brahma: Bhairava-self's heart (three-line verse kept whole).
ptvm-p01-v09.question: What womb?
ptvm-p01-v09.speaker: Bhairava (revealing)

ptvm-p02-v10.inference: This not yoginī-born, not Rudra gets plainly — heart of god of gods, at once yoga-release-giving.
premises: Heart of god of gods, at once yoga-release-giving (the prize).
ptvm-p02-v10.question: Who gets the heart?
ptvm-p02-v10.speaker: Bhairava (withholding)

ptvm-p02-v11.inference: On its utterance made rightly, great host goes at once to face-to-faceness, body-possession-marked.
premises: At once to face-to-faceness goes, body-marked (the fruit).
ptvm-p02-v11.question: What on right utterance?
ptvm-p02-v11.speaker: Bhairava (promising)

ptvm-p02-v12.inference: Remembering a moment in kiss, navel-sealed, he binds then all — body and mantra-host.
premises: A moment remembers, in kiss (the act).
He binds then all, body and host (the binding).
ptvm-p02-v12.question: Who binds?
ptvm-p02-v12.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptvm-p02-v13.inference: Asked, he tells even past and future; within a watch what meant, god-form voicing.
premises: Past-future-things asked he tells even (the knowledge).
Within a watch what meant (the speed).
ptvm-p02-v13.question: What does he tell?
ptvm-p02-v13.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptvm-p02-v14.inference: Face to face sees the undoubted drawn by Rudra-powers; by mere two watches sky-standing, remembering.
premises: By mere two watches sky-standing, remembering (the state).
ptvm-p02-v14.question: What does he see?
ptvm-p02-v14.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptvm-p02-v15.inference: By three the mothers, yogeśvarīs, heroes, perfected, strong śākinī-host gather.
premises: Heroes, hero-lords, perfected, strong śākinī-host (the troop).
ptvm-p02-v15.question: Who gathers?
ptvm-p02-v15.speaker: Bhairava (summoning)

ptvm-p02-v16.inference: Come, pledge got, Bhairava-urged — they give supreme accomplishment, whatever fruit wished.
premises: Having come, pledge got, urged (the arrival).
ptvm-p02-v16.question: What do they give?
ptvm-p02-v16.speaker: Bhairava (granting)

ptvm-p02-v17.inference: By this the accomplished will accomplish; mantra-men effected; all in Bhairava-tantra from this succeeds.
premises: By this the accomplished will accomplish (the future).
Whatever in tantra, all from this succeeds (the all — GRETIL v18ab absorbed here).
ptvm-p02-v17.question: What by this?
ptvm-p02-v17.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)

ptvm-p02-v18.inference: Who truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiated.
premises: Unseen circle even thus, anyone truly knows (the knowing).
ptvm-p02-v18.question: Who shares fruition?
ptvm-p02-v18.speaker: Bhairava (including)

ptvm-p03-v19.inference: By mere this known of all powers — śākinī-common even without yoga.
premises: By this, by mere known (the engine returns).
ptvm-p03-v19.question: What without yoga?
ptvm-p03-v19.speaker: Bhairava (freeing)

ptvm-p03-v20.inference: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns toward worship — time-fire to brahma-body.
premises: Time-fire from the first through māyā to brahma-body (the passage).
ptvm-p03-v20.question: Who turns?
ptvm-p03-v20.speaker: Bhairava (turning)

ptvm-p03-v21.inference: Boundless-ended Śiva, supreme triad deemed; whatever stands on the pure path inside that.
premises: Śiva boundless-ended, triad deemed supreme (the deeming).
ptvm-p03-v21.question: What stands inside?
ptvm-p03-v21.speaker: Bhairava (deeming)

ptvm-p03-v22.inference: The atom soon reaches pure lordly knowing; its impeller Śiva, all-knowing lord, to be known.
premises: Atom pure before long lordly (the ascent, whole-pāda fused).
Its impeller Śiva to be known, all-knowing lord (the turn).
ptvm-p03-v22.question: What does the atom reach?
ptvm-p03-v22.speaker: Bhairava (raising)

ptvm-p03-v23.inference: All-going, stainless, clear-full, self-aboded, bright — as banyan-seed tree, power-formed.
premises: As in banyan seed standing (the simile).
ptvm-p03-v23.question: What is the tree?
ptvm-p03-v23.speaker: Bhairava (imaging)

ptvm-p03-v24.inference: So the moving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows in truth — his going-to-freedom.
premises: His going-to-freedom (the fruit — runs to dīkṣā).
ptvm-p03-v24.question: What stands in the heart-seed?
ptvm-p03-v24.speaker: Bhairava (transferring)
uncertainties: nirvāṇagāminī feminine — dīkṣā of v25 is the subject (enjambment kept).

ptvm-p03-v25.inference: Initiation becomes-undoubted, oblation-free — on crown, face, heart, hidden, form.
ptvm-p03-v25.question: What initiation?
ptvm-p03-v25.speaker: Bhairava (initiating)

ptvm-p03-v26.inference: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered — with each one the ten quarters' binding.
premises: With each one the ten quarters bound (the closure — yojayet).
ptvm-p03-v26.question: What binding?
ptvm-p03-v26.speaker: Bhairava (binding)

ptvm-p03-v27.inference: Three claps before having given with sound for obstacle-quelling; topknot-count muttered, with water should sprinkle then.
premises: Three claps with sound before (the opening).
By topknot-count muttered, water then (the act — tataḥ absorbed).
ptvm-p03-v27.question: What first in rite?
ptvm-p03-v27.speaker: Bhairava (opening)

ptvm-p04-v28.inference: Flowers, mark or altar; by fourteen muttered, flower seat-making.
premises: Flower etc. in order, all (the offering).
ptvm-p04-v28.question: What seat?
ptvm-p04-v28.speaker: Bhairava (seating)

ptvm-p04-v29.inference: There the hero should worship emanation, then the seat; casketed, again worship begins.
ptvm-p04-v29.question: How worship?
ptvm-p04-v29.speaker: Bhairava (ordering)

ptvm-p04-v30.inference: Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the twenty-seven-muttered goddess.
premises: Full of realities, graced with ornaments (her praise — ābharaṇa not avayava).
Great lady worships (the subject — maheśānī not mahābhāgā).
ptvm-p04-v30.question: Whom worship?
ptvm-p04-v30.speaker: Bhairava (adoring)

ptvm-p04-v31.inference: Then fragrant flowers by power honored; with supreme devotion self offered.
premises: Then fragrant flowers by power (the offering).
ptvm-p04-v31.question: How honor?
ptvm-p04-v31.speaker: Bhairava (offering)

ptvm-p04-v32.inference: Worship told in fire-rite even this rule; whose rule done, rightly remembering seed, succeeds.
premises: Thus worship told, even fire-rite this rule (whole-pāda fused).
ptvm-p04-v32.question: What rule in fire?
ptvm-p04-v32.speaker: Bhairava (ruling)

ptvm-p04-v33.inference: Beginningless-endless blossoming seed mid-tithis, heart-lotus-housed — moon-ray ever practised.
premises: Beginningless-endless seed blossoming mid-tithis (the seed imaged).
ptvm-p04-v33.question: What meditate?
ptvm-p04-v33.speaker: Bhairava (sitting)

ptvm-p04-v34.inference: Whatever desires, them quickly got; from this to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
premises: Which desires, them quickly got (the grant — no ajñaḥ here).
From this to direct sight (the rise — asmāt).
ptvm-p04-v34.question: What may be got?
ptvm-p04-v34.speaker: Bhairava (granting)

ptvm-p04-v35.inference: Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
premises: Thus mantra-fruit-getting, this Rudrayāmala (the naming — fused).
ptvm-p04-v35.question: What is got?
ptvm-p04-v35.speaker: Bhairava (sealing)

ptvm-p01-v01.plain_english: O Lord, what is the Unsurpassable that grants Kaula fruit at once — known by a mere touch of knowing, rising to kinship with the Sky-Goer?
ptvm-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet

ptvm-p01-v02.plain_english: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulikī, mistress of the clan.
ptvm-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: etadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā

ptvm-p01-v03.plain_english: Tell me of her, Lord of gods, by whom I come to fullness. — Hear, blessed Goddess: even the answer has one beyond it — the Unsurpassable.
ptvm-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ labhāmyaham | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram

ptvm-p01-v04.plain_english: This Kaula rite, O Goddess, standing in my heart-sky — I tell it, O lady of gods: it gives swift Kaula fruit.
ptvm-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: kauliko'yaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomnyavasthitaḥ | kathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam

ptvm-p01-v05.plain_english: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are named.
ptvm-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: athādyāstithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānagāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau

ptvm-p01-v06.plain_english: Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in ka-series, in sounds, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.
ptvm-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate

ptvm-p01-v07.plain_english: Fourfold the holds of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them, śa beginning the famed row, and before, the five Brahmas.
ptvm-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: vāyvāgnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakam

ptvm-p01-v08.plain_english: Rootless, rightly ranged, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras indeed, and of wisdoms, O glorious one.
ptvm-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: amūlā tatkramājjñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā | sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini

ptvm-p01-v09.plain_english: This is the womb, told in all Tantras in every way — joined with the fourteen, O lucky one, joined with the tithi-lord's end; the third godhead, O fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.
ptvm-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ yoni samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvathā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ |

ptvm-p02-v10.plain_english: Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
ptvm-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam |

ptvm-p02-v11.plain_english: At its right speaking, the great mantra-seal host comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
ptvm-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān sadyastanmukhatāmeti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam |

ptvm-p02-v12.plain_english: Who remembers for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds then all, body and mantra-seal host, the man.
ptvm-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ saṃbadhnāti tadā sarvaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ |

ptvm-p02-v13.plain_english: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within a watch, uttering the meant god-form.

ptvm-p02-v14.plain_english: Face to face he sees the sure, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-standing, remembering.
ptvm-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran |

ptvm-p02-v15.plain_english: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
ptvm-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ vīrā vīreśvarāḥ siddhā balavāñcchākinīgaṇaḥ |

ptvm-p02-v16.plain_english: They come, pledge got, by Bhairava urged — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
ptvm-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yadvā samīhitam |

ptvm-p02-v17.plain_english: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect; whatever is in Bhairava's Tantra, all succeeds from this.
ptvm-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ yat kiñcidbhairavetantre sarvamasmāt prasidhyati |

ptvm-p02-v18.plain_english: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
ptvm-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ sa siddhibhāg bhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ |

ptvm-p03-v19.plain_english: By this mere knowing, all powers know; a kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
ptvm-p03-v19.sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ śākinīkulasāmānyo bhavedyogaṃ vināpi hi |

ptvm-p03-v20.plain_english: Ignorant of rite, knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
ptvm-p03-v20.sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati kālāgnimāditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntaṃ brahmadehagam |

ptvm-p03-v21.plain_english: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides inside that.
ptvm-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam tadantarvarti yatkiñcit śuddhamārge vyavasthitam |

ptvm-p03-v22.plain_english: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
ptvm-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ |

ptvm-p03-v23.plain_english: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
ptvm-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ yathānyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ |

ptvm-p03-v24.plain_english: So stands this moving-still world in the heart-seed; who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going.
ptvm-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaram evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī |

ptvm-p03-v25.plain_english: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, and heart, on the hidden, on the form, and so indeed.
ptvm-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye mūrtau tathaiva ca |

ptvm-p03-v26.plain_english: Placing done, topknot bound, twenty-seven-muttered; with each one let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.
ptvm-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām ekaikaṃ tu diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānāmapi yojayet |

ptvm-p03-v27.plain_english: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
ptvm-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye śikhāsaṃkhyātijaptena toyenābhyukṣayettataḥ |

ptvm-p04-v28.plain_english: Flowers and all in order — emblem or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
ptvm-p04-v28.sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā |

ptvm-p04-v29.plain_english: There let the hero worship the forthgoing, then the seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
ptvm-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya punaryajanamārabhet |

ptvm-p04-v30.plain_english: Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the goddess, twenty-seven-named.

ptvm-p04-v31.plain_english: Then with fragrant flowers, as able, let him honor; worship with supreme devotion, and offer up himself.
ptvm-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet pūjayet parayā bhaktyā ātmānaṃ ca nivedayet |

ptvm-p04-v32.plain_english: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
ptvm-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījaṃ prasidhyati |

ptvm-p04-v33.plain_english: Beginningless-endless seed, abloom, gone mid-tithis — housed in the heart-lotus, meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
ptvm-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśaṃ nityamabhyaset |

ptvm-p04-v34.plain_english: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; from this he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
ptvm-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt asmāt pratyakṣatāmeti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |

ptvm-p04-v35.plain_english: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness are won.

essence: Unsurpassable asked: Kaula fruit at once, mere knowing to Khecarī-evenness.
Secret asked: heart-abiding Kaulikī clan-mistress.
Fullness asked (gaining); answer beyond answers promised.
Kaula rite in heart-sky told; lady of gods; swift fruit.
First: drop-ending vowels; moon-sun by time's yoking.
Earth-to-person realities in five, ka-to-ma sounds.
Wind-fire-water supports fourfold; śa-famed brahma-five.
Rootless kṣa-ending emanation; of all mantras and wisdoms.
Ever-told womb; fourteen-joined; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.

rasa.justification: Wonder at immediacy — at-once fruit, mere-touch knowing — sharpened into seeking: Devī asks how. The phonematic ground amazes as power-map.

sections.BOUNDARY: No powers are shown; the host gathers beyond the ground laid here.
sections.EXPLANATION: Fierce question (katham = means): the unsurpassable granting Kaula fruit at once (sadyaḥ, recension-decided), recognition alone lifting to Khecarī-evenness. Secret asked: heart-abiding Kaulikī. Fullness asked as gaining (labhāmi, not going). Answer beyond answers promised; rite told in heart-sky to the lady of gods (transposed order kept). Ground: drop-ending vowels, moon-sun time-yoked; earth-to-person in five ka-to-ma SOUNDS (varṇeṣu, not classes); fourfold supports, śa-famed brahma-five (split kept); rootless kṣa-ending emanation of all mantras and wisdoms; ever-told womb in every way, fourteen-joined, tithi-lord-ended, third brahma — Bhairava-self's heart.
sections.FUNCTION: Asks the fierce question and lays the phonematic ground the answer will inhabit — in Lakṣmīrāma's recension readings.
sections.KEY TERMS: anuttara (unsurpassable Subject); katham (how — means); sadyaḥ (at once — immediacy, not autonomy); Kaulikī (feminine -ī); labhāmi (I gain — not I go); sureśānī (lady of gods — feminine addressee); varṇa (sounds — not classes); yoni (womb-source).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Question and ground: the how asked here is paid across powers, fruit, and rite.
sections.RELATED: Hanneder on KSTS 69 (late mss, needs revision); GRETIL root as collation base (sadyah/svataḥ, varṇa/varga, Kaulikī/Kaulinī); variant quote L75-76 excluded (commentary pāṭha).
sections.SUMMARY: What grants Kaula fruit at once, known by mere touch? The heart's Kaulikī, clan-mistress — tell her, for fullness gained. Even of the answer, one beyond: no doubt, at once, the rite in heart-sky, lady of gods. First vowels drop-ending, moon-sun time-yoked; earth-to-person in five ka-to-ma sounds; supports fourfold, brahma-five śa-famed; rootless kṣa-ending emanation of all mantras and wisdoms; womb ever told, fourteen-joined, third brahma — Bhairava-self's heart.

essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
Remembered a moment in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
By three: mothers, heroes, perfected, śākinī-host gather.
Come, pledge got, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
By this the perfected perfect; all in tantra succeeds.
Unseen circle truly known: shares fruition, yogin, initiated.

rasa.justification: Wonder at exhibited efficacy — withheld heart, face-to-face host, past-future told, mothers gathered — braced by vīra: powers wielded (bound, effected, succeeds).

essence: By mere this known of all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga.
Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns; time-fire to brahma-body.
Boundless Śiva, supreme triad; pure-path standers inside.
Atom reaches lordly knowing; impeller Śiva to be known.
All-going bright tree in banyan seed, power-formed.
Heart-seed world; knower's going-to-freedom.
Undoubted oblation-free initiation on five sites.
Placing done, topknot bound; all ten quarters bound.
Three claps sounded; topknot-count water then sprinkled.

rasa.justification: Knowing without apparatus, the atom arriving, the tree wholly in the seed, initiation without oblation — every verse stills. The banyan/heart-seed holism is quiescence imaged.

sections.BOUNDARY: No outer rite is given; the rite's body begins beyond the fruit.
sections.EXPLANATION: By mere this known of all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga. Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns toward worship: time-fire from the first through māyā to brahma-body. Boundless-ended Śiva, supreme triad deemed; whatever stands on the pure path inside that. Atom soon reaches pure lordly knowing (whole-pāda fused); its impeller Śiva to be known, all-knowing lord. All-going, stainless, clear-full, self-aboded, bright — banyan-seed power-formed tree (v23 absorbs GRETIL v24ab: no separator in source). So the moving world in the heart-seed; the true knower's going-to-freedom (feminine runs to dīkṣā). Initiation undoubted, oblation-free, on five sites (becomes-undoubted fused). Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; with each one the ten quarters bound (yojayet, not kārayet). Three claps with sound for obstacle-quelling; topknot-count muttered, water-then (tataḥ absorbed).
sections.FUNCTION: Tastes the fruit: knowing without apparatus, holism imaged, initiation internalized.
sections.KEY TERMS: jñātamātra (mere known — engine returns); vināpi yoga (even without yoga); sarvam sarvātmakam (holism); nirvāṇagāminī (going-to-freedom — runs to dīkṣā); nyāsa (placing); yojayet (should yoke — vs kārayet); datvā (short a).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Fruit of the powers exhibited before; the feminine going-to-freedom runs into the initiation verse.
sections.RELATED: v23/v24 re-division (yathā absorbed into v23) documented in lore; v25→v26 enjambment kept.
sections.SUMMARY: By mere this known of all powers, śākinī-common even without yoga. Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns: time-fire from the first through māyā to brahma-body. Boundless Śiva, supreme triad; the pure-pathed stand inside. The atom soon reaches lordly knowing; its mover Śiva to be known. All-going, stainless, clear-full, self-aboded, bright — banyan-seed tree, power-formed. So the moving world in the heart-seed; the true knower's going-to-freedom. essence: Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat.
Hero worships emanation, then seat; casketed, begin.
Realities-full, all-limbed goddess worshipped twenty-seven-muttered.
Fragrant flowers by power; devotion; self offered.
Worship told; fire-rite rule; seed remembered rightly succeeds.
Beginningless seed mid-tithis in heart-lotus; moon-ray practised.
Desires quickly got; unknowing to direct sight, no doubt.
Mantra-fruit got: Rudrayāmala; practice gives fruition.

rasa.justification: Injunctions accumulate — clap, sprinkle, seat, worship, casket, honor, meditate — yet every act closes (told, succeeded, got, no doubt). Vidhi weight without agitation.

sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing further is prescribed; practice is the last word.
sections.EXPLANATION: Flowers, mark or altar-or (sthaṇḍile'thavā); by fourteen muttered, flower seat-making. There the hero should worship emanation, then the very seat; casketed, again worship begins (punaryajanamārabhet fused). Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the twenty-seven-muttered goddess (ābharaṇa, maheśānī kept). Then fragrant flowers by power honored; with supreme devotion self offered (ātmanaṃ, not svātman). Worship told in fire-rite even this rule (whole pāda fused); whose rule done, rightly remembering seed, succeeds. Beginningless-endless blossoming seed mid-tithis, heart-lotus-housed; moon-ray ever practised (fused). Which desires, them quickly got; from this to direct sight (no ajñaḥ in recension) — all-knowingness, no doubt. Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala (whole pāda fused); from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
sections.FUNCTION: Gives the rite's body, then seals the tantra: told, practised, got.
sections.KEY TERMS: sthaṇḍila (altar — ṇ); sampuṭīkṛtya (casketing); maheśānī (great lady — nominative subject); ātman (self — oblation); abhyāsa (practice — last word); rudrayāmala (colophon name); etadbhyāsataḥ (from-this-practice).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The rite's body answers the method-question of the opening; the colophon closes the how with got.
sections.RELATED: Title-verse v31? No — colophon is v35 (etad rudrayāmalam); no ajñaḥ in v34 (asmāt starts the fruit).
sections.SUMMARY: Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat. The hero worships emanation, then the seat; casketed, begins. Realities-full, all-ornamented, the great lady worships the twenty-seven-muttered goddess. Fragrant flowers by power, supreme devotion — self offered. Worship told; even in fire this rule: seed rightly remembered succeeds. Beginningless seed mid-tithis, heart-lotus-housed; moon-ray ever practised. Desires quickly got; to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt. Mantra-fruit got: this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, fruition, all-knowingness.

that by mere knowing brings Khecarī-evenness?
ptvm-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet

lines: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the heart-dwelling Power,

ptvm-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: etadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā

lines: Tell me of her, god of gods, by whom to fullness I attain —

ptvm-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ labhāmyaham | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram
